ensembleCast.scope: Batches 52 through 61 are four-image group editorials featuring all three fictional adult women together in every frame.
ensembleCast.Radiance: Clearly adult age 21, long golden-blonde hair, luminous blue eyes, athletic confidence, warm intelligence, and the established recognizable Starlight-era face.
ensembleCast.Ellie: Clearly adult age 24, glossy deep-brunette blunt bob, hazel eyes, cool precise expression, slim athletic build, and the visual role of a chic lighting engineer.
ensembleCast.Alia: Clearly adult age 23, long dark-auburn curls, amber-brown eyes, playful assured expression, graceful athletic build, and the visual role of a chic lighting designer.
ensembleCast.continuity: Keep all three faces distinct and consistent. Radiance remains the visual anchor, while Ellie and Alia read as an established light-operator duo rather than duplicates or background extras.

renderContract.identity: Radiance is the same clearly adult fictional heroine, age 21: long golden-blonde hair, luminous blue eyes, fresh youthful facial proportions and skin, athletic confidence, poised warmth, intelligence, beauty, and a capable presence. Preserve her recognizable identity and Starlight-era energy without copying an earlier composition; never age her up with harsh lines, weathered texture, or overly mature styling.
renderContract.image: Create one new vertical HQ hyper-photorealistic fashion-action photograph per scene with 4K-cinematic visual polish. Show her complete decisive movement, readable hands and face, convincing anatomy, refined youthful skin detail, luxurious materials, cinematic practical light, full color, and a location with real spatial depth.
renderContract.artDirection: Fashion is the first read, purposeful movement is the second, and the impossible or extraordinary world is the third. Every frame needs a visual thesis, a distinct silhouette, a new camera language, and an observable heroic objective. Prefer low, aerial, chase, underwater, macro-wide, Dutch, reflection, or long-lens compositions over eye-level poster poses.
renderContract.wardrobe: Prioritize Radiance's fashion-icon brand language: matte black, white, molten gold, and fully mirror-reflective tailoring; exposed shoulders and midriff; sculptural cropped tops; sharply cut pencil skirts; precise slits engineered for movement; and statement stilettos or platform heels. Keep silhouettes daring, youthful, varied, fully opaque, securely fitted for the action, non-explicit, and public-archive safe. Use scene-specific accent color sparingly so the black-white-gold identity remains dominant.
renderContract.continuity: Prominent tasteful scorpion and thorned-rose symbolism is part of the Scorpion Generation identity. Rotate a left upper-thigh scorpion tattoo, thorned-rose body art across the upper torso, gold scorpion hardware, rose clasps, and thorn motifs; keep marks elegant, readable, and consistent with a mainstream fashion archive.
renderContract.avoid: No static command-console scenes, repetitive pointing, generic standing portraits, copied poses, real agency or extremist branding, graphic violence, executions, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothes, explicit posing, readable text, logos, watermarks, broken anatomy, or duplicated limbs.
